segments.speaker: M
segments.text: My landlord just sent me a notice about renewing my lease. The rent is going up by 15 percent.

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: Ouch. That’s a pretty steep increase. Are you going to stay?

segments.speaker: M
segments.text: I’m torn. The location is perfect—it’s a stone’s throw from my office—but that’s a lot more money every month.

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: Have you thought about negotiating? Sometimes landlords are willing to meet you halfway, especially if you’ve been a reliable tenant.

segments.speaker: M
segments.text: That’s not a bad idea. I’ve never missed a payment in three years. Maybe I can use that as leverage.

segments.speaker: W
segments.text: Exactly. The worst they can say is no.

plainText: My landlord just sent me a notice about renewing my lease. The rent is going up by 15 percent. Ouch. That’s a pretty steep increase. Are you going to stay? I’m torn. The location is perfect—it’s a stone’s throw from my office—but that’s a lot more money every month. Have you thought about negotiating? Sometimes landlords are willing to meet you halfway, especially if you’ve been a reliable tenant. That’s not a bad idea. I’ve never missed a payment in three years. Maybe I can use that as leverage. Exactly. The worst they can say is no.

evidence.supportingLine: The rent is going up by 15 percent.

whyOthersFail.1: 위치는 오히려 장점으로 서술된다 — 'The location is perfect—it’s a stone’s throw from my office'.
whyOthersFail.2: 계약은 갱신 통지를 받은 상태이고, 만료가 걱정거리로 제시되지 않는다. 걱정의 대상은 갱신 조건(인상액)이다.
whyOthersFail.3: 집주인과 연락이 안 된다는 서술은 없다. 오히려 먼저 통지를 보내 왔고, 여자는 협상을 권한다.

evidence.keyedAnswerText: He has a history of paying rent on time.
evidence.supportingLine: I’ve never missed a payment in three years.

whyOthersFail.0: 이사 계획은 나오지 않는다. 남자는 남을지 말지를 저울질하는 단계다.
whyOthersFail.1: 새 직장 이야기는 없다. 사무실은 3년째 다니는 곳으로 전제되어 있다.
